title: Grateful Dead Live at Hofheinz Pavilion on 1972-11-19
source: Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel (7.5ips 2 track/Dolby B); Transfer Info: Reel (Dolby B Decoded) -> WAV (24bit/96k); Mastering Info: WAV (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16; Reels supplied and Transferred By David Gans; Mastered By Charlie Miller; This is a cleaned up version of source ID 122783

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy night highlighted by a soaring Dark Star > Weather Prelude > Half Step suite and marathon Paying in the Band.
ai_review.review: The show is consistently described as tight and spectacular, with the second set delivering extended jams like Dark Star into Weather Prelude and Half Step, plus a 20‑minute Paying in the Band. Reviewers note clear, well‑balanced soundboard audio with no major flaws, making the performance easy to enjoy despite one reviewer finding the overall inspiration average.

ai_rating.rationale: Five enthusiastic reviews (four 5‑star, one 4‑star) praise both musical performance and sound quality; the combined show and recording assessment yields a rating near the top of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and balanced mix with good bass presence; no reported drop‑outs, muddiness, or other issues.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Weather Prelude > Half Step
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid but described as less inspired by one reviewer; second set builds into extended, seamless jams that are the highlight of the night.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned for greeting fans and stage anecdotes; no specific performance critique beyond his presence.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass work praised as nicely mixed; vocal contributions noted on Box of Rain and I Know You Rider.
